title: State Openness Doctrine
subtitle: Regulations on civil liberties, information control, and geopolitical borders.

autarki.label: Total Isolated State (Autarky)
autarki.desc: Completely closed from the outside world, strict state censorship of press and internet, banned demonstrations, and total economic autarky.

proteksionis.label: Protectionist & Authoritarian State
proteksionis.desc: The government restricts citizen movement and immigration, filters media outlets, and limits protest rights to preserve domestic order.

moderat.label: Moderate & Mixed State
moderat.desc: Balances individual rights, social public order regulations, and pragmatic openness to international trade.

demokratis.label: Open & Democratic State
demokratis.desc: Freedom of speech and press guaranteed, borders open, uncensored digital network, and strong budget transparency.

globalis.label: Globalist & Free Market State
globalis.desc: Full protection of human rights, uninhibited journalistic freedom, visa-free borders, and seamless trade integration.

speechScore.title: Freedom of Speech & Expression
speechScore.desc: The degree to which citizens can voice opinions, critique officials, and debate public policies without fear of state reprisal.
speechScore.lowNotice: Strict censorship on anti-regime discourse; legal penalties for dissenting voices.
speechScore.highNotice: Universal freedom of expression with full protection for diverse political dialogue.

religionScore.title: Freedom of Religion & Belief
religionScore.desc: Constitutional guarantee for citizens to practice, establish, or change their faith without governmental discrimination.
religionScore.lowNotice: Religions monitored by state agencies; unapproved denominations prohibited.
religionScore.highNotice: Robust protection of religious freedom and minority worship places nationwide.

demoScore.title: Right to Assembly & Demonstration
demoScore.desc: Ease with which citizens can gather peacefully in public spaces to advocate for civic causes.
demoScore.lowNotice: Public rallies forbidden and promptly dissolved by law enforcement.
demoScore.highNotice: Peaceful protests legally safeguarded without burdensome municipal permits.

transparencyScore.title: Government Transparency & Integrity
transparencyScore.desc: Openness of public expenditures, government procurement tenders, and anti-corruption oversight.
transparencyScore.lowNotice: State budgets and financial records classified under state secrecy directives.
transparencyScore.highNotice: Public procurement and state budgets audited and published openly to all citizens.

mediaScore.title: Press Freedom & Mass Media
mediaScore.desc: Independence of news broadcasting stations and investigative reporters from official state censorship.
mediaScore.lowNotice: All broadcasting networks operate strictly under the information ministry guidelines.
mediaScore.highNotice: Investigative journalism investigates state governance freely without intimidation.

internetScore.title: Open Internet & Digital Access
internetScore.desc: Availability of uncensored global internet, social platforms, and international web traffic.
internetScore.lowNotice: The state enforces a national firewall; global internet access is heavily restricted.
internetScore.highNotice: Uncensored internet access with high-speed digital infrastructure.

borderScore.title: Border Openness & Visa Policy
borderScore.desc: Entry procedures for foreign tourists, skilled expats, immigrants, and cross-border trade travelers.
borderScore.lowNotice: Heavily fortified borders; foreign visa issuances are virtually nonexistent.
borderScore.highNotice: Universal visa-free entry for international travelers to stimulate tourism and investments.

tradeScore.title: Trade Tariffs & Economic Openness
tradeScore.desc: Tariff barriers on imports and exports, customs regulations, and trade quotas.
tradeScore.lowNotice: Steep protectionist tariffs and strict quotas enforced to mandate import substitution.
tradeScore.highNotice: Zero-tariff free trade zones and broad liberalization of international commerce.

diplomacyScore.title: Global Engagement & Diplomacy
diplomacyScore.desc: Participation in international multilateral forums, diplomatic treaties, and UN peace operations.
diplomacyScore.lowNotice: Rigid isolationist stance; avoids international treaties and conventions.
diplomacyScore.highNotice: Proactive diplomatic leadership in multilateral alliances and global peacekeeping missions.
